welcomeHeroSubtitle.message: Convert and save any image as PNG, JPG, or WebP

welcomeStep1Text.message: Find any image on a webpage and right-click it to open the context menu.

welcomeStep2Text.message: Hover over "Save Image As" to see available formats.

welcomeStep3Text.message: Pick PNG, JPG, or WebP. The image is converted instantly in your browser and downloaded.

welcomePrivacyTitle.description: Privacy box heading on the welcome page

welcomePrivacyText.message: All conversion happens locally in your browser. No images are uploaded to any server. No tracking, no analytics.
